metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-05-14"
  description: "Empty seed for us-apply re-walk converges fixture"

scenarios:
  "99.3-001-mcp-initialize":
    description: "MCP server returns HTTP 200 and a well-formed JSON-RPC envelope for a valid initialize POST to /mcp"
    service: mcp
    path: tests/mcp/mcp_endpoint_test.go
    last_updated: "2026-11-07"
    user_stories:
      - story: docs/product/stories/99.3-rewalk-fixture.yaml
        scenario_id: 99.3-001-mcp-initialize
        merge_date: "2026-11-07"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the MCP server is running on its configured port
        - the server accepts JSON-RPC over HTTP POST at /mcp
      when:
        - the Claude User posts a valid JSON-RPC initialize request to /mcp
      then:
        - the server returns HTTP 200
        - and the response body is a well-formed JSON-RPC envelope referencing the request id
  "99.3-002-mcp-get-refused":
    description: "MCP server returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed for a GET request to /mcp"
    service: mcp
    path: tests/mcp/mcp_endpoint_test.go
    last_updated: "2026-11-07"
    user_stories:
      - story: docs/product/stories/99.3-rewalk-fixture.yaml
        scenario_id: 99.3-002-mcp-get-refused
        merge_date: "2026-11-07"
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the MCP server is running on its configured port
      when:
        - the Claude User sends an HTTP GET request to /mcp
      then:
        - the server returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed
        - and the response indicates the method is not allowed for this endpoint
